chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from al-Saqr ibn Dulf. He said:

I asked Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them) about monotheism, and I said to him that I take the doctrine of Hisham ibn al-Hakam. So he (peace be upon him) became angry and said: 'What is with you and the doctrine of Hisham? Whoever claims that Allah is a body is not of us, and we dissociate from him in this world and the Hereafter. O Ibn Dulf! Surely, a body is generated, and Allah is its generator and its maker.'

key_terms.الْجِسْمَ مُحْدَثٌ: A body is generated: the theological argument that all bodies are created, therefore God cannot be a body since He is the uncreated Creator

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali al-Hadi say about those who claim Allah is a body in al-Amali?
ai.summary: Imam Ali al-Hadi (AS) reacts with anger when al-Saqr ibn Dulf says he follows the anthropomorphist doctrine of Hisham ibn al-Hakam. The Imam declares that whoever claims Allah is a body is not of the Ahlul Bayt's followers, and they dissociate from such a person. He argues that a body is created, while Allah is the Creator and Shaper of bodies.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Ibrahim narrated to us from his father from al-Saqr b. Dulf. He said:

I asked Abu’l Hasan `Ali b. Muhammad b. `Ali b. Musa al-Rida (as) about monotheism, and I said that I take the doctrine of Hisham b. al-Hakam. So, he (as) became angry and said: What is with you and the doctrine of Hisham? Whoever alleges that Allah is a body is not of us, and we dissociate from him in this world and the Hereafter. O Ibn Dulf! Surely, a body is generated, and Allah is its generator and its maker.
